name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Live Cups for 2–8 racers with customizable presets, track drafting, live rankings and buffered spectator POV.
changelog: Track removal with score rollback, spectator freecam and viewer counts, and host-only physics warnings. Unified fixed-height lobby with inline preset editing, embedded chat, simpler player controls and lighter labels. Fixed setup disconnects and duplicate racers, rapid checkpoint-reset DNFs, rematch setup, preset icons and lingering notices. Removed tournament/review exports, separate organizer screens and the spectator dropdown; preset sharing and local autosaves remain.
